review_basis: The five-case inventory is internally consistent, including two parameterized missing/truncated-artifact outcomes.
Toolchain pins match the isolated installation evidence: 36 packages, all 32 prior package versions preserved, SDK 1.34.0, CLI 1.9.1 / server 1.32.0, and the pinned CLI archive and binary digests.

The contract defines the artifact verifier and launch guard, exact synthetic workflow behavior, retention and typed duplicate oracles, same-store restart/history identity, private evidence handling, and owned-process lifecycle.

The pinned official CLI v1.9.1 source observation documents FrontendIP binding for frontend/internal RPC, HTTP, and metrics configuration; runtime inspection of actual owned listeners remains a required independent assertion. Source-to-binary reproducible-build attestation is explicitly not claimed.
The TC plan explicitly records the formerly pending execution decisions as resolved by the contract.

deadline_review.mechanism: The main-thread autouse fixture enforces monotonic per-case deadlines with ITIMER_REAL, reserves 5 seconds for ordinary cleanup and 25 seconds for integration cleanup, and applies each remaining budget to blocking operations. Timeout cleanup signals all saved process handles concurrently, then force-kills/reaps within one shared cleanup deadline. The runner's separate 300-second watchdog snapshots proven pytest descendants before cleanup.
deadline_review.pre_gate_check: Before any service or test execution, independently inspect frozen implementation to verify signal/timer setup and restoration, timeout non-catchability/failed status, remaining-budget propagation, unconditional cleanup, shared cleanup deadline, and the runner descendant snapshot/fencing behavior.

authorization_boundary.authorized_next_step: Implement the H1 helper, fixtures, runner, and five qualification cases against this exact contract.
authorization_boundary.not_authorized_by_this_review: Starting the Temporal server or executing tests. A separate independent source pre-gate review is required after implementation and before first execution.
authorization_boundary.original_acceptance: No B03 business workflow or original AT acceptance is claimed.
